name: mimo-computer-use
description: Cross-platform local computer-use tools for MiMo and OpenAI-compatible models in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Let MiMo and compatible models operate the desktop through local MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: MiMo Computer Use exposes a small, conservative set of local desktop automation tools to Codex. It delegates actual Windows and macOS control to separately installed open-source adapters such as Windows-MCP, Peekaboo, or Trope CUA, keeping this plugin isolated from the mimo2codex proxy runtime.
